'''''Shatterpoint''''' is a novel written by [[Matthew Stover]]. The first novel in the Clone Wars novel series and the first released in the [[Clone Wars multimedia project|''Clone Wars'' multimedia project]], it was originally published as a hardcover by [[Del Rey]] in [[June]] [[2003]]. The paperback edition was published in [[April]] [[2004]], with a prologue by [[George Lucas]] and the short story [[Equipment (short story)|''Equipment'']], also written by Stover. The eBook of ''Shatterpoint'' was released in [[December]] [[2005]]. The novel was republished on [[June 15]], [[2021]] as part of ''[[The Essential Legends Collection]]''.<ref name="Edelweiss">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/174351/shatterpoint-star-wars-legends-by-matt-stover|text=Shatterpoint: Star Wars Legends}}</ref>

The story centers on [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] as he attempts to rescue his former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]], from his homeworld of [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]]. Caught up in the [[Summertime War]], Mace found himself dealing with, among other things, the religious consequences of war and the toll it takes on people. However, he was too late to save the one person who was like a daughter to him. Lured to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] by [[Kar Vastor]] (the last of [[Ghôsh Windu]], aside from Mace), Depa attacked and was defeated by her former master. Upon being returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Billaba remained floating in [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] in an insane status. Though her physical wounds would heal, she would remain comatose until her end.
